sources.method: Live Chrome 155 DOM/computed-style measurement, explicit 1440x1000 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewport, isolated context.

evidence.finding: Selected product headline/section/body/CTA styles and region bounds at desktop/mobile viewports.
Original Folio artwork, composition and getting-started flow reuse the measured hierarchy with system-ui fonts. No pixel identity or complete Apple site library is claimed.

prototype.reason: An inspectable gallery package with local synthetic state needs no framework/backend. This choice does not prescribe a future product stack.
prototype.run: python3 scripts/gallery.py build --output <empty-directory>; serve the output with python3 -m http.server

new_screen.reason: Getting started page reuses the type/control grammar and provides validated empty/loading/error/retry/success form states.

visual.reason: Desktop/mobile captures reviewed against the measured source type hierarchy and control styles. Original product illustration and layout are intentional adaptations.

states.reason: Finish selection, navigation disclosure, Escape/focus, FAQ and local form states exercised.

responsive.reason: Desktop/mobile viewport screenshots and no-horizontal-overflow checks at 390/768/1440 CSS px. New screen checked at 390 px; physical devices not tested.

accessibility.reason: Scoped check: named controls, keyboard focus and Escape restoration, disabled state, local status messages and selected contrast pairs. This is not a complete WCAG/VoiceOver or native accessibility audit.

publication.notes: Authored implementation and measurements. No Apple image, logo, font file, application binary, user data or source dump.
